description: This file contains functions and classes for handling sales and purchase return processes in an ERP system, including validation, document creation, and rate calculations.

classes.name: StockOverReturnError
classes.description: Custom validation error class for stock over-return scenarios.

methods.name: validate_return
methods.description: Main validation function for return documents, checks if return is applicable and calls further validation functions.

methods.name: validate_return_against
methods.description: Validates the return against the original document, including date, exchange rate, and stock update conditions.

methods.name: validate_returned_items
methods.description: Validates the items being returned, including quantity, serial numbers, batch numbers, and warehouse requirements.

methods.name: validate_quantity
methods.description: Checks if the return quantity does not exceed the allowable maximum and is negative.

methods.name: get_ref_item_dict
methods.description: Builds a dictionary of reference item details from database rows.

methods.name: get_already_returned_items
methods.description: Fetches items already returned against a document to prevent over-returning.

methods.name: get_returned_qty_map_for_row
methods.description: Retrieves the total returned quantities for a specific document row.

methods.name: make_return_doc
methods.description: Creates a return document based on a source document, handling item quantities, serial numbers, and related data.

methods.name: get_rate_for_return
methods.description: Calculates the rate for a return item based on stock ledger entries and other factors.

methods.name: get_return_against_item_fields
methods.description: Returns the field name used for linking return items to original documents based on document type.

methods.name: get_filters
methods.description: Builds filters for querying stock ledger entries for rate calculation.

methods.name: get_returned_serial_nos
methods.description: Retrieves serial numbers of items already returned for a specific document item.
